title: Rule-Bound Magic System
body: Structured arcane system defining energy sources, hard rules, physical costs, training tiers, and forbidden paradoxes.

fields.name: Energy Source
fields.options: Ambient Aether|Starlight & Moons|Vocal True-Names|Blood & Vital Heat|Crystal Resonance|Borrowed Spirit Pacts

fields.name: Required Focus or Catalyst
fields.hint: Tuning forks, chalk sigils, silver ink, or breath control

fields.name: Physical or Moral Toll
fields.hint: Frostbite, temporary blindness, accelerated aging, or metal fatigue

sampleValues.Required Focus or Catalyst: Cast bronze or star-quartz tuning chimes
sampleValues.Hard Limitations (What It Cannot Do): Cannot alter living minds, raise the dead, or function inside vacuum chambers where sound cannot travel.
sampleValues.Physical or Moral Toll: Over-channeling shatters bones along acoustic fault lines and leaves permanent tinnitus.
sampleValues.Schools & Mastery Tiers:
Apprentice | Sustain single-note shields | Cracked chime
Maestro | Weave harmonic bridges across chasms | Deafness & bone fracture
sampleValues.Forbidden Magic & Paradoxes: Singing the Seventh Dissonance collapses local gravity into a ringing sinkhole.
